trailhead.label: Sportplatz Vöran bus stop, the board’s start

cautions: Wide forest road shared with farm and forestry vehicles: lead on.
Meadows beside the road are farmed and closed to dogs in Vöran: keep to the road.
Short stretch on the Hafling road into the village at the end: keep your dog close.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
